name: Station
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the retrieved Station checkout, packaged builds use electron-updater, poll for updates every 30 minutes, and can quit and install after an update is downloaded; the Windows electron-builder configuration explicitly sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature to false. The effective updater verification behavior remains framework-dependent.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; release metadata and the framework's internal verification implementation were not audited.

original_evidence.text: | Station | getstation/desktop-app | Electron (`electron-updater`), Yarn workspaces monorepo (`packages/app`) | Y | auto (chk/dl automatic — `periodicTick(30 min)` saga calls `checkForUpdates()` on a timer unless `STATION_NO_CHECK_FOR_UPDATE` env is set, plus an initial check on app `READY`; install requires explicit user action dispatching `QUIT_AND_INSTALL`) | Y | https (GitHub Releases via `electron-updater`'s default `publish: {provider: 'github'}`, owner/repo inferred from `package.json` "repository", i.e. `getstation/desktop-app`) | manifest present (`latest.yml`, TLS only, not independently signed) | hash-from-manifest nominally, BUT Windows Authenticode verification is EXPLICITLY DISABLED (`verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false`) — same weakening as Caprine | none effective on Windows / OS-trust-store on macOS (Squirrel.Mac still enforces signing-identity match for the mac target) | `packages/app/src/auto-update/sagas.ts:24,90-98` (`POLL_UPDATE_INTERVAL = ms('30mins')`; `main()` wires `periodicTick(POLL_UPDATE_INTERVAL)` → `checkForUpdates` unless `process.env.STATION_NO_CHECK_FOR_UPDATE`); `packages/app/src/services/services/auto-updater/main.ts:16-26` (`quitAndInstall()` only calls `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` if a download already completed, else just `app.quit()` — i.e. requires the update to have finished downloading and a user-initiated quit/install action); `packages/app/electron-builder.yml:3-4,50-54` (`publish: {provider: 'github'}`; `win: {target:[nsis], verifyUpdateCodeSignature: false}`) |
